subject: general
question: After independence, co-operatives became an integral part of which planning initiative in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Five-Year Plans.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Co-operatives became an integral part of the Five-Year Plans in India, as they were seen as a crucial mechanism for socio-economic development.**
 
• **The First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956) emphasized agricultural development and rural reconstruction, where cooperatives were actively promoted.**
 
• **Cooperatives were considered essential for pooling resources, improving agricultural productivity, and ensuring equitable distribution of profits among farmers.**
 
• **Over the years, the cooperative movement expanded into sectors like banking, housing, dairy, and marketing, playing a vital role in economic growth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Industrial Policy Resolution:** The Industrial Policy Resolutions of 1948 and 1956 were focused on laying the foundation for India's industrial development. They categorized industries into private, public, and joint sectors to enable planned industrial growth. While cooperative societies were mentioned, they were not the central focus.
 
• **Green Revolution:** The Green Revolution in India (1960s) aimed at increasing agricultural productivity through the introduction of high-yielding variety seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation techniques. Though cooperatives played a role in distribution, the initiative primarily revolved around technological advancements in agriculture.
 
• **Operation Flood:** Operation Flood, launched in 1970 by the National Dairy Development Board (NDDB), was aimed at increasing milk production in India. It was a significant initiative to create a nationwide milk grid, which heavily relied on dairy cooperatives but was focused solely on the dairy sector.
